description: Capability for the main window, the floating desktop-sprite window and the undocked panel windows (`panel-*`, see PANEL_WINDOWS in main.rs) -- grants the core JS APIs the frontend actually uses via window.__TAURI__ (withGlobalTauri): invoking commands and listening for events such as telemetry-update and code-chat-delta. A window missing from this list gets no core API at all: the page loads, and the first listen fails with `plugin:event:listen not allowed by ACL` in front of the operator, which is what the AETHER CODE board did on its first run. Custom #[tauri::command]s (chat, TTS, scanner, updates, sprite window control) aren't gated by this file -- only Tauri's own built-in core APIs are.
